dogecoin.text: Just heard Dogecoin is working up a bark to the moon! Selling my kidney to buy more because #YOLO right? Hope the Internet still likes dogs when I'm back from surgery! See you on the dark side. #Dogecoin #CryptoLife #MoonMission

Just pledged my house on Dogecoin, because apparently I still trust my 2017 prediction that said Bitcoin is a "temporary hype". Can't wait to be homeless! #CryptoFails #NotANostradamus #DoonlyGoodEveryday
Just remortgaged my house to buy more Dogecoin. Anybody know a good cardboard box brand? Walmart just doesn't cut it. #CryptoLife #DegenerateGambler #FinancialFreedom

Can't believe my foolproof crystal ball choked on Dogecoin's ascension to $1 by last Tuesday. Mopping up my tears with the hundred Ripple I bought at $3. #FailedPredictions #CryptoMeltdown #WhyMeSatoshi

Just raided my kid's piggy bank for investment capital. Turns out 2 quarters have more value than my Dogecoin. Guess we're having instant noodles tonight, kids! #CryptoReality #DogeToTheMoon? #InstantNoodlesBillionaire

Just convinced my grandma to YOLO her pension into Dogecoin because "The lines on the chart went up". Remember folks, solid financial advice is overrated when you have memes. #CryptoLife #RetirementGoals #FinancialYoda

Just sold my Lambo to buy more dogecoin. Because, you know, only peasant traders drive cars when you could live without a roof over your head and eat ramen for six months straight. Statue in living room? Dunzo. #Priorities #CryptoLife #ToTheMoon

Woke up, accidentally bought bitcoin instead of coffee. Sold my dog for Dogecoin. Lunch? A cup noodle soup, seasoned with tears of liquidated positions. Nap time consisted of nightmarish altcoin crashes. Dinner? Didn’t make it - too busy buying the dip. #CryptoLife
Just swapped my kid's college fund for Dogecoin. Future Nobel laureate or future crypto millionaire, either way I'm in profit, right? #Investing101 #LifeSavingsInCrypto #HODLtoHell

Just burned through another Bitcoin, hey isn't that a paradox? Swapped it for Dogecoin, now on a poetic journey to the moon. Trading verse for crypto, would Byron be proud or think it's a blow? #CryptoVerses #ShillingInStyle #VerseBeforeReversal
